visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera pans across a meticulously maintained Japanese-style garden under a bright, slightly overcast sky. The foreground features a low bamboo fence and a lush green lawn. Two large bonsai trees are positioned near a stone-paved path leading to a modern building. (2) Inside the restaurant, the scene shows minimalist wooden tables and chairs arranged in a spacious dining area. The room is brightly lit with warm indoor lighting and natural light from large floor-to-ceiling windows. Potted plants and wooden lattices add to the serene atmosphere. (3) A sequence of close-ups showcases various Japanese set meals (Teishoku) on a light wood table. A large bowl of brownish soba noodles on a bamboo mat is the centerpiece, surrounded by small bowls containing salad, miso soup, and dark ceramic side dishes. (4) Hands enter the frame using dark chopsticks to lift a bunch of thin soba noodles from the mat. The noodles are then dipped into a small ceramic cup filled with a dark soy-based broth. The camera captures the texture of the noodles clearly. (5) Another close-up reveals pieces of crispy fried chicken (Karaage) served on a black plate with a small side salad. A hand uses chopsticks to pick up a golden-brown piece of chicken, showing its crunchy exterior. A bowl of fluffy white rice is shown. (6) Slices of seared Wagyu beef are shown in a bowl with grilled zucchini slices. The beef has a dark, caramelized crust. A hand lifts a piece of meat with chopsticks, placing it onto a spoonful of rice and sautéed onions. (7) A hand places a tall glass of frothy yellow pineapple juice on a wooden coaster, followed by a glass of dark iced coffee with a thick layer of foam. The background shows the green garden through the window, emphasizing the refreshing drinks. (8) The final shots return to the garden and the building exterior. Traditional Chinese text overlays appear on the screen, providing the restaurant's name and location. The camera remains steady, capturing the peaceful environment and the modern architectural lines.
